In summary, our research is concerned with

the study of the background gluon field effects on B -> X_s l^+ l^- and B -> X_s \gamma gamma decays, which are the two main channels for the determination of the Cabibbo-Kobayashi-Maskawa matrix element |V_{ts}|.
the study of non-perturbatively produced gluonic fields and their effects on the energy spectra of photons emitted in B -> Xs gamma gamma.
the non-perturbantive QCD effects on B -> X_s l^+l^-.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
non-perturbatively induced background gluons in the B meson decay to two photons are a small effect.
the gluon background effects in B -> X(s)gamma gamma are not negligible.
the background gluon effects are negligible in the energy spectrum of B -> X_s l+l-.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the background gluon effects are important and can be sizable for B -> X_s l+ l- and B_s -> l+ l-.
non-perturbatively generated QCD effects on B -> X_s l+l- are small and can be neglected, but that they can have a significant impact on B_s -> l+l- and B_s -> gamma + gamma.
the gluon field effects are not important in B -> X(s) gamma, but can become important in B -> gamma gamma and B_s -> gamma.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the energy spectrum of B -> X_s (B_s) gamma gamma is not the same as that of B -> X_c (B_c) gamma gamma.
the gluon background field can be treated as a perturbation in B -> X(s) gamma, and the gluon field is a source of non-perturbativity in B_s -> X(s)gamma gamma.
non-perturbatively generated gluon fields can have a significant impact on the energy spectra of either photon in B -> X(s) gamma(gamma).
